requiresAdmin.description: Relaunch NetDeploy as administrator before deploying.

parameters.description: Asked once, before the first step.

install.description: Where the app is installed. Steps use {InstanceDir} for the app's folder, and {Instance} or {InstanceSuffix} ("" or "-name") in service and task names.

folder.description: The install folder, usually "{InstallDir}". A single install goes straight into it; each instance gets a subfolder.

instances.description: The app can run as several named instances side by side.

default.description: Pre-fills the field. Can use {Name} values.

options.description: The choices for a choice input.

powershell.description: A script whose last output line is True or False.

ask.description: A Yes/No question asked at run time.

minVersion.description: Lowest acceptable version. For dotnetRuntime, the same major version is required.

name.description: installedProgram: part of the name shown in Apps and Features.

key.description: registryValue: a key such as HKLM\SOFTWARE\Vendor\Product.

valueName.description: registryValue: a value under the key.

script.description: powershell: a script that outputs True or False.

checkPrerequisiteStep.description: Confirms something is installed, and runs the bundled installer when it is not.

installer.description: Installer inside the package, run when the check fails.

installerArgs.description: Arguments for the installer, such as /install /quiet /norestart.

name.description: Shown in the UI instead of the generated description.

when.description: The step is skipped when this is false.

inputs.description: Asked just before the step runs. Answers become {Name} values for this and later steps.

continueOnError.description: Carry on with the next step if this one fails.

cleanup.description: Steps that undo this one when the install is removed, replacing the built-in undo. [] means nothing to undo.

copyFilesStep.description: Copies a folder from the package to the server. Config files are merged with the server's copy and reviewed before they are written.

to.description: The target folder on the server.

preserve.description: Globs for files kept when they already exist, such as logs or data.

deleteExtra.description: Delete target files that are not in the package. Preserved files, config files and .deploy are kept.

configs.description: Globs for the config files that are merged instead of copied. Default: **/appsettings*.json and **/*.config.

takeNew.description: Setting paths, such as Logging, where the package's value always wins.

name.description: Shown in the UI instead of the generated description.

inputs.description: Asked just before the step runs. Answers become {Name} values for this and later steps.

continueOnError.description: Carry on with the next step if this one fails.

cleanup.description: Steps that undo this one when the install is removed, replacing the built-in undo. [] means nothing to undo.

runExeStep.description: Runs an exe, such as a database migrator.

path.description: Relative paths are inside the package; absolute paths are on the server.

timeoutMinutes.description: Kill the process after this long.

args.description: Arguments for a script file, passed as with powershell -File. Quote paths with double quotes, not single quotes.

edition.description: windows runs powershell.exe (default), core runs pwsh.exe.

password.description: Password for the account, usually a secret {Name} input.

program.description: The program to run, when not using definition.

runAs.description: Account to run the task as, such as SYSTEM.
